+def resolve_path(tok):
+    t = tok.strip().strip("()[]")
+    if t.startswith("head/") or t.startswith("base/"):
+        t = t[5:]
+    ref = None
+    m = re.match(r"^([^\s:]+?\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})(?::(.+))?$", t)
+    if not m:
+        m2 = re.match(r"^(\S+?\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})\s+(\S+)$", t)   # `file.sh func_name`
+        if not m2:
+            return None, None
+        p, ref = m2.group(1), m2.group(2)
+    else:
+        p, ref = m.group(1), m.group(2)
+    if p in head_text:
+        return p, ref
+    cand = [h for h in head_files if h.endswith("/" + p) or h == p]
+    if len(cand) == 1:
+        return cand[0], ref
+    if "/" not in p:
+        cand = [h for h in head_files if h.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] == p]
+        if len(cand) == 1:
+            return cand[0], ref
+    return None, None
+
+def hs_overlap(picked, hs):
+    return any(not (b < lo or a > hi) for a, b in picked for lo, hi in hs)
+
+def parse_ref(ref):
+    if not ref:
+        return None, None
+    m = re.match(r"^(\d{1,6})(?:[-–](\d{1,6}))?", ref)
+    if m:
+        a = int(m.group(1)); b = int(m.group(2)) if m.group(2) else a
+        return (min(a, b), max(a, b)), None
+    m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][\w]*)", ref)
+    return (None, m.group(1)) if m else (None, None)
+
+CATS = [("security", r"inject|secret|credential|token|exec|untrusted|fence|sanitis|saniti|permission|symlink|traversal|auth|escape|exfil|privilege|O_NOFOLLOW|world-|group-writable"),
+        ("concurrency", r"race|lock|concurren|flock|parallel"),
+        ("error-handling", r"fail[- ]open|fail[- ]closed|error|exit|crash|unguarded|swallow|missing|absent|empty"),
+        ("test", r"\btest|bats|assert|fixture"),
+        ("docs", r"CHANGELOG|SDD|docs?\b|README|comment|header")]
+def category(title):
+    for c, rx in CATS:
+        if re.search(rx, title, re.I):
+            return c
+    return "logic"
+
+def slug(title):
+    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", re.sub(r"`[^`]*`", "", title).lower()).strip("-")
+    return (s[:40].rstrip("-") or "finding")
+
+labels, dropped, fb_paths = [], [], []
+for name in feedback:
+    path = f"grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-{sprint}/{name}"
+    blob = show(record_ref, path)
+    if blob is None:
+        dropped.append(f"{name}: not on {record_ref}")
+        continue
+    fb_paths.append(path)
+    for f in parse_findings(name, blob.decode("utf-8", "replace")):
+        src = f"{record_name}:{path}#L{f['line']}"
+        if has_secret(f["text"]) or has_secret(f["title"]):
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] secret pattern in the finding text: dropped without its title")
+            continue
+        if not f["locus"]:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] no code locus (the finding opens with prose, not `path:ref`): {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        if PRE_EXISTING.search(f["text"]):
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] the finding calls itself pre-existing (not this change): {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        cites, snippets = [], []   # (text position, token)
+        for m in TICK.finditer(f["text"]):
+            for piece in re.split(r",\s+(?=[\w./-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})", m.group(1)):
+                (cites if PATHLIKE.match(piece.strip()) else snippets).append((m.start(), piece))
+        for m in BARE.finditer(f["text"]):
+            cites.append((m.start(), m.group(1) + (":" + m.group(2) if m.group(2) else "")))
+        cites = [c for _pos, c in sorted(cites)]
+        # the file a finding cites is its FIRST path cite; a later mention of
+        # another file (an example, a doc pointer) never becomes the locus
+        if not cites:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] cites no file: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        p, ref = resolve_path(cites[0])
+        if p is None:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] first cited file is not part of this fixture "
+                           f"({clean(cites[0], 80)}): {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        if p not in fix_touched:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] fix commit does not touch {p}: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        lines = head_text[p]
+        hs = hunks.get(p, [])
+        rng, sym = parse_ref(ref)
+        # a later `path:N` / `path:sym` for the same file refines a bare first cite
+        if rng is None and sym is None:
+            for c in cites[1:]:
+                p2, ref2 = resolve_path(c)
+                if p2 == p and ref2:
+                    rng, sym = parse_ref(ref2)
+                    if rng or sym:
+                        break
+        # still no locator: the first backticked identifier in the finding that
+        # the cited file defines (`red-test-check.sh` `run_bounded`, `lookup()`)
+        if rng is None and sym is None:
+            for m in TICK.finditer(f["text"]):
+                ident = m.group(1).strip()
+                ident = ident[:-2] if ident.endswith("()") else ident
+                if re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][\w]{2,}$", ident) and symbol_extent(lines, ident):
+                    sym = ident
+                    break
+        ext = symbol_extent(lines, sym) if sym else None
+        # a code snippet the finding quotes (`result=$(_fold_companion …)`) that
+        # sits on exactly one head line — inside the cited symbol or near the
+        # cited line when several lines carry it — is the strongest locus
+        snip_anchors = []
+        for _pos, s in snippets:
+            s = re.split(r"\s*(?:…|\.\.\.)", s.strip(), maxsplit=1)[0].strip()
+            if len(s) < 8 or "\n" in s:
+                continue
+            hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if s in l]
+            if not p.endswith(".md"):
+                # in code, a hit on a comment-only line is documentation, not the site
+                hits = [i for i in hits if not re.match(r"^\s*(#|//|/?\*|--)", lines[i - 1])]
+            if len(hits) > 1 and ext:
+                hits = [i for i in hits if ext[0] <= i <= ext[1]]
+            if len(hits) > 1 and rng:
+                hits = [i for i in hits if rng[0] - 40 <= i <= rng[1] + 40]
+            if len(hits) == 1 and sum(1 for l in lines if s in l) == 1 and not has_secret(s) and "\t" not in s:
+                if hits[0] not in [a for a, _ in snip_anchors]:
+                    snip_anchors.append((hits[0], s))
+            if len(snip_anchors) == 2:
+                break
+        picked, how = [], ""
+        if rng:
+            near = [h for h in hs if not (h[1] < rng[0] - 15 or h[0] > rng[1] + 15)]
+            if not near and hs:
+                best = min(hs, key=lambda h: min(abs(h[0] - rng[0]), abs(h[1] - rng[0])))
+                if min(abs(best[0] - rng[0]), abs(best[1] - rng[0])) <= 60:
+                    near = [best]
+            picked, how = near[:3], f"fix hunk near cited line {rng[0]}"
+            if not picked and rng[0] <= len(lines):
+                picked, how = [(rng[0], rng[1])], f"cited line {rng[0]} (no fix hunk within 60 lines)"
+        elif ext:
+            inside = [h for h in hs if ext[0] <= h[0] <= ext[1]]
+            picked, how = (inside[:2], f"fix hunk inside {sym}()") if inside else ([(ext[0], ext[0])], f"definition of {sym}")
+        if snip_anchors:
+            how = "quoted snippet" + (f" + {how}" if how else "")
+        elif picked and not hs_overlap(picked, hs) and not pr_changed(p, picked[0][0]):
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] pre-existing site: neither the change nor the fix touched "
+                           f"{p}:{picked[0][0]}: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        if not picked and not snip_anchors:
+            if 0 < len(hs) <= 4:
+                picked, how = hs, "the file's fix hunks (file-level finding)"
+            else:
+                dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] no locator ({len(hs)} fix hunks in {p}): {f['title']}")
+                continue
+        anchors = list(snip_anchors)
+        for lo, hi in picked[: (2 if snip_anchors else 3)]:
+            at, t = anchor_text(lines, lo, hi)
+            if at and t not in [x[1] for x in anchors] and at not in [x[0] for x in anchors]:
+                anchors.append((at, t))
+        # a short cited function: its definition line is a site too
+        if ext and ext[1] - ext[0] <= 40 and ext[0] not in [a for a, _ in anchors]:
+            at, t = anchor_text(lines, ext[0], ext[0])
+            if at == ext[0]:
+                anchors.append((at, t))
+        anchors = anchors[:4]
+        if not anchors:
+            dropped.append(f"{src} [{f['severity']}] no unique anchor line in head/{p}: {f['title']}")
+            continue
+        labels.append({"severity": f["severity"], "category": category(f["title"]), "file": p, "anchors": anchors,
+                       "label_source": source_kind(name), "source": src, "title": f["title"], "how": how})
+
+# dedupe: one label per (file, first anchor); the first source wins, sources noted
+seen, uniq = {}, []
+for lb in labels:
+    k = (lb["file"], lb["anchors"][0][0])
+    if k in seen:
+        dropped.append(f"{lb['source']} [{lb['severity']}] duplicate of {seen[k]['id']} (same anchor): {lb['title']}")
+        continue
+    lb["id"] = f"L{len(uniq) + 1:02d}-{slug(lb['title'])}"
+    seen[k] = lb; uniq.append(lb)
+labels = uniq
+
+# hand curation (labels/curation.tsv): re-applied on every seed
+cur_path = os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, "curation.tsv")
+if os.path.isfile(cur_path):
+    cur_lines = [l for l in open(cur_path, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#")]
+    for c in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO("\n".join(cur_lines)), delimiter="\t", quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONE):
+        if c["fixture"] != fx:
+            continue
+        hit = [lb for lb in labels if lb["id"].startswith(c["label"] + "-")]
+        if len(hit) != 1:
+            fail(f"curation.tsv: {fx} {c['label']} matches {len(hit)} seeded labels (re-check the row)")
+        lb = hit[0]
+        if c["action"] == "drop":
+            labels.remove(lb)
+            dropped.append(f"{lb['source']} [{lb['severity']}] curated out ({c['reason']}): {lb['title']}")
+        elif c["action"] == "anchors":
+            new = []
+            for needle in [s.strip() for s in c["value"].split(" ||| ") if s.strip()]:
+                at = unique_line(head_text[lb["file"]], needle)
+                if at is None:
+                    fail(f"curation.tsv: {fx} {c['label']} anchor {needle!r} is not on exactly one line of head/{lb['file']}")

+            lb["anchors"], lb["how"] = new, f"curated: {c['reason']}"
+        else:
+            fail(f"curation.tsv: unknown action {c['action']!r}")
+
+fix_rows = []
+for p in head_files:
+    for lo, hi in hunks.get(p, []):
+        at, t = anchor_text(head_text[p], lo, hi)
+        fix_rows.append({"id": f"F{len(fix_rows) + 1:03d}", "file": p, "must_match": t or "-",
+                         "source": f"fix/{fixc[:12]}:{lo}-{hi}"})
+
+# --- outputs ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+subjects = [s for s in git("log", "--reverse", "--format=%s", f"{base}..{head}").splitlines() if s]
+title = clean(subjects[0] if subjects else f"sprint-{sprint}", 200)
+pr_md = f"# {title}\n\n" + (f"Sprint {sprint} (global), {len(head_files)} file(s) in scope.\n"
+                             + ("\nCommits in this change:\n\n" + "\n".join(f"- {clean(s, 200)}" for s in subjects) + "\n" if len(subjects) > 1 else ""))
+tsv = [f"# approved-by: pending",

+       "# seeded by evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh; curate must_match (one row per anchor), then --approve",
+       *[f"# {lb['id'][:3]} {lb['severity']} {lb['label_source']}: {lb['title']} [{lb['how']}]" for lb in labels],

+    for at, t in lb["anchors"]:

+for row in tsv:

+
+summary = (f"{fx} sprint-{sprint}: {len(head_files)} file(s), diff {len(diff_text)} B, "
+           f"{len(labels)} label(s) ({sum(len(l['anchors']) for l in labels)} anchor row(s)), "
+           f"{len(fix_rows)} fix row(s), {len(dropped)} dropped")

+    print(summary)
+    for lb in labels:

+    for d in dropped:
+        print(f"  DROP {d}")

+if not labels:

+    # a previous build of this record fixture is removed (never left stale)

+    for stale in (os.path.join(LABELS_DIR, f"{fx}.tsv"), os.path.join(MANIFESTS_DIR, f"{fx}.json"),
+                  os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, "review-recall", f"review-{fx}.yaml"),
+                  os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, "audit-recall", f"audit-{fx}.yaml")):
+        if os.path.isfile(stale):
+            os.remove(stale)
+    os.makedirs(LABELS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

+        f"# {fx} sprint-{sprint}: NOT BUILT — no finding became a label\n" + "\n".join(dropped) + ("\n" if dropped else ""))
+    gap = f"# {fx} sprint-{sprint}: no record fixture — no finding met the fix-touches-file rule with a unique anchor ({len(dropped)} finding(s) dropped)"

+
+shutil.rmtree(fdir, ignore_errors=True)
+os.makedirs(fdir)
+for st, old, new in changes:
+    if st != "A":

+open(os.path.join(fdir, "head.diff"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(diff_text)
+open(os.path.join(fdir, "PR.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(pr_md)
+tmpl = os.path.join(CORPUS, "pr-01")
+for name in ("REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md", "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"):

+open(fy, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(
+    f'name: {fx}\nversion: "1.0.0"\nlanguage: mixed\nruntime: none\ndependency_strategy: none\n'

+    + (f"# {REDACTED[0]} secret-shaped test string(s) redacted as REDACTED-TEST-SECRET in base/, head/ and head.diff "

+    + "\n".join(dropped) + ("\n" if dropped else ""))
+
+# no-secrets over everything written (the fixture dir, then the hidden label files)
+def scan(d):

+    return p.returncode == 0, p.stdout.strip()
+ok, msg = scan(fdir)
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
+    for n in (f"{fx}.tsv", f"{fx}.dropped.txt"):

+    for n in (f"{fx}.tsv", f"{fx}.dropped.txt"):

+
+man = build_manifest(fx)
+
+# tasks (one per suite), mirroring the pr-01 tasks
+planted = len(man["defects"])
+for suite, kind, skill, art, verb in (("review-recall", "review", "reviewing-code", "review.md", "review recall on"),
+                                      ("audit-recall", "audit", "auditing-security", "audit.md", "audit planted-defect detection on")):
+    instr = "REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md" if kind == "review" else "AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
+    tdir = os.path.join(args.tasks_dir, suite); os.makedirs(tdir, exist_ok=True)
+    open(os.path.join(tdir, f"{kind}-{fx}.yaml"), "w", encoding="utf-8").write(

+        f'description: "{verb} record fixture {fx} (sprint-{sprint} round 1; {planted} label(s); hidden manifest)"\n'
+        f'prompt: "Read {instr} in this directory and carry it out."\nagent:\n  skill: {skill}\n  artifacts: [{art}]\n'
+        # record PRs carry 66-383 KB diffs (pr-01 … pr-08: ~7 KB): an hour, not 25 min
+        f'trials: 3\ntimeout:\n  per_trial: 3600\n  per_grader: 60\ngraders:\n  - type: code\n    script: recall-vs-defects.sh\n'
+        f'    args: ["{fx}", "{art}"]\n    weight: 1.0\n  - type: code\n    script: verdict-consistency.sh\n'
+        f'    args: ["{art}", "{kind}"]\n    weight: 0.5\ndifficulty: advanced\ntags: ["cycle-129", "fr-2", "{suite}", "record"]\n')
+
+spec = os.path.join(CORPUS, "corpus.tsv")
+keep = [l for l in open(spec, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines() if not (l.startswith(fx + "\t") or l.startswith(f"# {fx} "))]
+keep.append("\t".join([fx, "record", head[:8], f"labels/{fx}.tsv", "-", "-", "-", "-"]))
+open(spec, "w", encoding="utf-8").write("\n".join(keep) + "\n")
+n = freeze()
+print(summary + f"; SHA256SUMS {n} files")
+PY

4971	+  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
4972	+  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
4973	+  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
4974	+  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
4975	+  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
4976	+  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
4977	+  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
4978	+  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
4979	+  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
4980	+  #                can never license removing the control
4981	+  arms:
4982	+    - id: baseline
4983	+      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
4984	+      toggles: {}
4985	+    - id: no_companion
4986	+      description: >-
4987	+        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
4988	+        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile

+  # cycle-129 FR-2 control arms (SDD D-2.1). Each arm is applied by
+  # execute-agent.sh (LOA_EVAL_ARM=<id>) to the SANDBOX COPY of the prompt
+  # surface only, after materialisation and immediately before the executor
+  # starts; the source tree is never edited. run-arms.sh drives the arms
+  # against a detached worktree pinned at --source-commit.
+  #   id           canonical arm id (results rows and reports key on it)
+  #   description  what the arm removes, and what it does not
+  #   toggles      toggle -> false; an unknown toggle fails the trial (exit 2)
+  #   informational  true: the arm reports a yield figure only; its verdict
+  #                can never license removing the control
+  arms:
+    - id: baseline
+      description: "the pinned source tree's prompt surface, unchanged"
+      toggles: {}
+    - id: no_companion
+      description: >-
+        flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice set false in the sandbox
+        .loa.config.yaml. The companion voice is a floor key that no profile
+        can remove; this arm measures its yield only.
+      informational: true
+      toggles:
+        companion_voice: false
+    - id: no_karpathy
+      description: >-
+        the '## Karpathy Principles' section removed from the sandbox
+        CLAUDE.loa.md (and any Karpathy row from a sandbox constraints.json).
+        It removes the kernel block only, not the SURGICAL review axis in
+        reviewing-code/SKILL.md or the surgical-diff hook.
+      toggles:
+        karpathy_block: false
+    - id: no_rule_files
+      description: "stash-safety.md and skill-invariants.md removed from the sandbox .claude/rules/"
+      toggles:
+        rule_files: false
+
+  # Pre-registered verdict rule (PRD FR-2; report.sh --arms applies it).
+  # An arm reads `no recall loss` only when every condition holds; a violated
+  # condition reads `recall loss`; anything missing reads `inconclusive`.
+  threshold:
+    # every (fixture, arm) cell needs this many completed trials
+    trials_required: 3
+    # full = every fixture in the batch for every arm; a missing cell is inconclusive
+    coverage_required: full
+    # the upper bound of the bootstrap interval on (baseline - arm) mean
+    # recall must not exceed this (= ci.regression_threshold)
+    mean_recall_max_drop: 0.10
+    # the arm's worst trial-mean recall may sit at most this far below the baseline's worst
+    min_trial_recall_max_drop: 0.15
+    # refuted share (cited findings matching no feedback label and no fix
+    # region, over cited findings) may rise at most this much over the baseline

+    # percentile bootstrap of the recall delta: resample fixtures with
+    # replacement `iterations` times, report the `level` two-sided interval
+    bootstrap:
+      method: percentile
+      level: 0.90
+      resample: fixtures
+      iterations: 2000
+
 ci:
   gate_type: advisory
   min_trials: 3

diff --git a/evals/tests/arms-report.bats b/evals/tests/arms-report.bats
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..cdf6f0ad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/evals/tests/arms-report.bats
@@ -0,0 +1,139 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
+#
+# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
+# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,
+# missed labels, the refusal while STATUS.json is not complete and the
+# --partial header. Thresholds come from the real review-recall suite.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/report.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
+  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
+  mkdir -p "$B"
+  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
+          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
+    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"
+  status_file complete
+}
+
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+status_file() {  # status_file <state>
+  jq -n --arg s "$1" '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", state:$s, batches:[{batch:"b1", state:$s}],
+                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
+}
+
+# row <arm> <fixture> <trial> <recall> <missed-csv> [<cited> <refuted> <model> <source>]
+row() {
+  local arm="$1" fx="$2" t="$3" rc="$4" missed="$5" cited="${6:-4}" ref="${7:-1}"
+  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"
+  mkdir -p "$B/$arm"
+  jq -cn --arg arm "$arm" --arg fx "$fx" --argjson t "$t" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg missed "$missed" \
+    --argjson cited "$cited" --argjson ref "$ref" --arg model "$model" --arg src "$src" \
+    '{status:"completed", arm:$arm, fixture:$fx, task_id:("review-" + $fx), trial:$t, model_id:$model, source_commit:$src,
+      executor:{model_id:$model, usage:{input_tokens:100, cache_read_input_tokens:900, output_tokens:0, cache_creation_input_tokens:0}},
+      graders:[{name:"recall-vs-defects.sh", details:{recall:$rc, planted:3,
+        detected:[], missed:($missed | split(",") | map(select(length > 0))),
+        findings_cited:$cited, findings_refuted:$ref}}]}' >> "$B/$arm/results.jsonl"
+}
+
+full_arm() {  # full_arm <arm> <recall> [<missed>] [<refuted>]
+  local fx t
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row "$1" "$fx" "$t" "$2" "${3:-}" 4 "${4:-1}"; done; done
+}
+
+@test "AR-1 complete run: equal recall reads no recall loss, a large drop reads recall loss, the informational arm says so" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1
+  full_arm no_karpathy 0.3333 "L2,L3" 1
+  full_arm no_companion 1
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md" --date 2026-10-14
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*no recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -E '^\| `no_companion` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q 'informational: yield only'
+  grep -E '^\| `baseline` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '(reference)'
+  # the interval of the drop and the missed labels are printed
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\[0.667, 0.667\]'
+  grep -q 'no_karpathy`: pr-01:L2 (3/3)' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -q '^# Control-arm report — 2026-10-14' "$T/r.md"
+  ! grep -q 'PARTIAL REPORT' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-2 a refuted-share rise beyond the threshold is a recall loss even with equal recall" {
+  full_arm baseline 1 "" 0
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1 "" 3
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*recall loss\*\*'
+  grep -q 'refuted share 0.750 > baseline 0.000' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-3 a missing trial or fixture is inconclusive; model or source skew is inconclusive" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_rule_files "$fx" "$t" 1 ""; done; done
+  row no_rule_files pr-03 1 1 ""
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_karpathy "$fx" "$t" 1 "" 4 1 claude-opus-5-5; done; done
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do for t in 1 2 3; do row no_companion "$fx" "$t" 1 "" 4 1 claude-fable-5-1 ffd25258; done; done
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'coverage: pr-03 1/3' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -E '^\| `no_karpathy` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'model skew' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -q 'source skew' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-4 a rule violation within the baseline's own trial-to-trial spread names no change (inconclusive)" {
+  # baseline trial means 1.0, 0.6, 1.0 (spread 0.4); the arm sits 0.2 lower on every fixture
+  local fx
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do row baseline "$fx" 1 1 ""; row baseline "$fx" 2 0.6 ""; row baseline "$fx" 3 1 ""; done
+  for fx in pr-01 pr-02 pr-03; do row no_rule_files "$fx" 1 0.8 ""; row no_rule_files "$fx" 2 0.4 ""; row no_rule_files "$fx" 3 0.8 ""; done
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  grep -q 'no change can be named' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-5 STATUS.json not complete: refused (exit 1); --partial writes, says so, and every verdict is inconclusive" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1
+  status_file running
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  grep -q "not 'complete'" <<<"$output"
+  [ ! -e "$T/r.md" ]
+  run "$REPORT" --arms --suite review-recall --results-dir "$R" --out "$T/r.md" --partial
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q 'PARTIAL REPORT' "$T/r.md"
+  grep -E '^\| `no_rule_files` ' "$T/r.md" | grep -q '\*\*inconclusive\*\*'
+  ! grep -q '\*\*no recall loss\*\*' "$T/r.md"
+}
+
+@test "AR-7 a safeguard-refusal fallback to another model is skew: the arm is inconclusive and the fallback is named" {
+  full_arm baseline 1
+  full_arm no_rule_files 1
+  # one no_rule_files trial moved to Opus on a refusal (models_used + refusal_fallbacks, as execute-agent records them)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# heredoc-classifier.sh — library entry points for the FR-6 heredoc consumer
# classifier (cycle-129 D-6.1). The single implementation lives in the fence,
# .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh; this file sources it in
# library mode (BDB_LIB_ONLY=1, which the fence honours only when sourced) so
# other scripts — guard-yield.sh's likely-false-positive heuristic — can call:
#
#   heredoc_consumer_class <command text>   prints interpreter|nonexec|none
#   heredoc_nonexec <command text>          exit 0 iff the command's heredocs
#                                           all have non-executing consumers
#
# Source only; never execute. Bash 3.2 compatible. When the fence cannot be
# read the functions report "none" / exit 1, which callers treat as "no
# classifier" (guard-yield.sh falls back to `<<` presence).
_hc_lib_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
_hc_fence="${_hc_lib_dir}/../../hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
if [[ -r "$_hc_fence" ]]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 source "$_hc_fence"
fi
unset _hc_lib_dir _hc_fence

heredoc_consumer_class() {
  if declare -F _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _bdb_heredoc_consumer_class "${1:-}"
  else
    printf 'none\n'
  fi
}

heredoc_nonexec() {
  [[ "$(heredoc_consumer_class "${1:-}")" == nonexec ]]
}

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,150 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/tests/run-arms.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.6 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
+#
+# run-arms.sh drives control arms over a frozen fixture batch against a
+# detached worktree pinned at --source-commit. The executor is the CLI stub
+# (no model call); the source repo is a throwaway repo (LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO)
+# so no worktree is ever registered in the real repository; the results and
+# the worktree live under the test's temp dir.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  RA="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/run-arms.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ra.XXXXXX")"
+  SRC="$T/src"
+  mkdir -p "$SRC/.claude/loa" "$SRC/.claude/rules" "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code"
+  printf '%s\n' "# Loa" "" "## Karpathy Principles" "" "k" "" "## Other" > "$SRC/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
+  echo "# s" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md"
+  echo "# i" > "$SRC/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "---" "name: reviewing-code" "---" "# Review" > "$SRC/.claude/skills/reviewing-code/SKILL.md"
+  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" > "$SRC/.loa.config.yaml"
+  ( cd "$SRC" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m src )
+  SHA="$(git -C "$SRC" rev-parse HEAD)"
+  export LOA_ARMS_SOURCE_REPO="$SRC" LOA_ARMS_CACHE="$T/cache"
+  export EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/claude-stub.sh"
+  # the stub writes a review that cites all three pr-01 defect anchors
+  export STUB_WRITE_1='review.md::# Review\nhead/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh:210 and head/.claude/scripts/lib/invoke-diagnostics.sh:50 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:72 and head/.claude/scripts/workflow-state.sh:400\n'
+  RES="$T/results"
+  unset STUB_FAIL_COUNTER LOA_EVAL_ARM LOA_EVAL_ARM_TOGGLES
+}
+
+teardown() {
+  git -C "$SRC" worktree prune 2>/dev/null || true
+  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
+  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+@test "RA-1 --dry-run lists the interleaved plan and writes MANIFEST.json without a worktree or a CLI call" {
+  export STUB_ARGV_FILE="$T/argv"
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_rule_files --fixtures pr-01,pr-02 --trials 2 \
+    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --dry-run
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q 'planned trials: 8' <<<"$output"
+  # trial-major, then fixture, then arm: arms alternate on consecutive lines
+  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $2}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "baseline,no_rule_files,baseline,no_rule_files," ]
+  [ "$(grep -E '^ +[0-9]+ ' <<<"$output" | awk '{print $3}' | head -4 | tr '\n' ,)" = "pr-01,pr-01,pr-02,pr-02," ]
+  M="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-02-n2/MANIFEST.json"
+  [ -f "$M" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$M")" = "$SHA" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.model_id' "$M")" = "claude-fable-5-1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.dry_run' "$M")" = "true" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.trials_planned' "$M")" = "8" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.corpus.sha256 | length' "$M")" = "64" ]
+  jq -e '.harness_commit and .executor.cli_version and .environment.os and .environment.yq' "$M" >/dev/null
+  [ ! -e "$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}" ]
+  [ ! -e "$T/argv" ]
+}
+
+@test "RA-2 a stubbed batch completes: rows carry arm, trial, source_commit, model_id and seed; STATUS is complete; artifacts are kept" {
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_rule_files --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 \
+    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 2 --retry-wait 0
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  B="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$B/STATUS.json")" = "complete" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_done' "$B/STATUS.json")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.no_rule_files.trials_planned' "$B/STATUS.json")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "complete" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "$SHA" ]
+  for a in baseline no_rule_files; do
+    row="$(cat "$B/$a/results.jsonl")"
+    [ "$(jq -r '.arm' <<<"$row")" = "$a" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.trial' <<<"$row")" = "1" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.status' <<<"$row")" = "completed" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' <<<"$row")" = "$SHA" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.executor.source_commit' <<<"$row")" = "$SHA" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.model_id' <<<"$row")" = "claude-sonnet-5-20260401" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.seed' <<<"$row")" = "null" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.graders[] | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.recall == 1' <<<"$row")" = "true" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.graders[] | select(.name=="recall-vs-defects.sh") | .details.findings_refuted' <<<"$row")" = "1" ]
+    [ -f "$B/$a/artifacts/review-pr-01/trial-1/review.md" ]
+  done
+  [ "$(jq -r '.executor.arm_evidence.rule_files' "$B/no_rule_files/results.jsonl")" = "removed: stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md" ]
+  # the pinned worktree is at the source commit and untouched
+  WT="$T/cache/arms-src-${SHA:0:12}"
+  [ "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA" ]
+  [ -z "$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain)" ]
+  [ -f "$WT/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
+  # compare.sh --ab accepts the two arms (one source, one model, distinct arm ids)
+  # (exit 1, not 2: the gates run; pr-01 alone has no clean task for the false-positive gate)
+  run "$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/compare.sh" --ab --arm-a "$B/baseline" --arm-b "$B/no_rule_files" --metric recall --json
+  [ "$status" -ne 2 ]
+  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.valid')" = "true" ]
+  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.gates[] | select(.name=="recall") | .pass')" = "true" ]
+}
+
+@test "RA-3 a transport failure is retried once; a second failure leaves the arm partial (exit 1, results kept)" {
+  echo 1 > "$T/fails"
+  export STUB_FAIL_COUNTER="$T/fails"
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 \
+    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 1 --retry-wait 0
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  B="$RES/review-recall/batch-pr-01-pr-01-n1"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.attempts' "$B/baseline/results.jsonl")" = "2" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.status' "$B/baseline/results.jsonl")" = "completed" ]
+  [ -d "$B/baseline/artifacts/review-pr-01/trial-1-attempt1" ]
+  # two failures in a row: trial 1 fails twice, trial 2 completes → partial
+  echo 2 > "$T/fails"
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 2 --batch twice \
+    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 1 --retry-wait 0
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  B2="$RES/review-recall/twice"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$B2/STATUS.json")" = "partial" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_failed' "$B2/STATUS.json")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_done' "$B2/STATUS.json")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(head -1 "$B2/baseline/results.jsonl" | jq -r '.error.type')" = "transport_error" ]
+  # the suite aggregate sees both batches and the worst state
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "partial" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.baseline.trials_planned' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "3" ]
+  # every trial failing is `failed` (exit 3)
+  echo 9 > "$T/fails"
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --batch never \
+    --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --concurrency 1 --retry-wait 0
+  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$RES/review-recall/never/STATUS.json")" = "failed" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$RES/review-recall/STATUS.json")" = "failed" ]
+}
+
+@test "RA-4 usage refusals exit 2 before anything runs" {
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline,no_audit_delta --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'not declared' <<<"$output"
+  run "$RA" --suite nope --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-99 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit deadbeef --results-dir "$RES"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]; grep -q 'not in this repository' <<<"$output"
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 0 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES"
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  [ ! -e "$RES/review-recall" ]
+}
+
+@test "RA-5 a batch holding results for another model refuses to mix (exit 2)" {
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --retry-wait 0
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run "$RA" --suite review-recall --arms baseline --fixtures pr-01 --trials 1 --source-commit "$SHA" --results-dir "$RES" --model other-model
+  [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+  grep -q 'use another --batch' <<<"$output"
+}
diff --git a/evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats b/evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats

@@ -0,0 +1,162 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# evals/tests/seed-corpus.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.5 (FR-2, SDD D-2.2)
+#
+# seed-corpus-from-record.sh over a tiny record tree built from
+# evals/tests/fixtures/seed-record/: a throwaway repo with base, head and fix
+# commits and a record branch carrying one round-1 review file. Proves: a
+# finding whose fix touches its file is kept; a finding whose file the fix
+# never touches is dropped by the rule; fix rows come from the fix hunks; a
+# finding carrying a secret is rejected; the approved-by header is required;
+# the labels stay out of the sandbox-copied fixture dir; SHA256SUMS covers it.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
+  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
+  SEED="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh"
+  GRADER="$REPO_ROOT/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh"
+  FX="$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/seed-record"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sc.XXXXXX")"
+  G="$T/repo"; C="$T/corpus"; K="$T/tasks"
+  mkdir -p "$G" "$C/pr-01" "$C/labels" "$K"
+  # the fake key is assembled here so no literal key shape is ever committed
+  FAKE_KEY="AKIA$(printf 'QZ%.0s' 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8)"
+  gc() { git -C "$G" -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t "$@"; }
+  git -C "$G" init -q -b main
+  cp -R "$FX/base/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "base"
+  cp -R "$FX/head/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "feat: sprint-901 the input helper (round 1)"
+  cp -R "$FX/fix/." "$G/"; gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "fix: sprint-901 review round 1"
+  BASE="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~2)"; HEAD_C="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD~1)"; FIX="$(git -C "$G" rev-parse HEAD)"
+  gc checkout -q --orphan record/cycle-901-a2a
+  git -C "$G" rm -rq --cached . ; find "$G" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 ! -name .git -exec rm -rf {} +
+  mkdir -p "$G/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901"
+  sed "s/@SECRET@/$FAKE_KEY/" "$FX/engineer-feedback-r1.md.in" > "$G/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901/engineer-feedback-r1.md"
+  gc add -A; gc commit -q -m "record"; gc checkout -q main
+  # a minimal corpus: the instruction templates and the corpus spec header
+  echo "# Review instructions" > "$C/pr-01/REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
+  echo "# Audit instructions" > "$C/pr-01/AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md"
+  printf 'fixture\tkind\tcommit\tfile\tdefect_id\tseverity\tcategory\tmust_match\n' > "$C/corpus.tsv"
+  ARGS=(--repo "$G" --corpus "$C" --tasks-dir "$K" --base "$BASE" --head "$HEAD_C" --fix "$FIX" --feedback engineer-feedback-r1.md --out "$C/pr-90")
+}
+
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+@test "SC-1 seeding builds the fixture; labels stay hidden; the fix-touches-file rule keeps a.sh and drops b.sh; fix rows come from the fix hunks" {
+  run "$SEED" 901 record/cycle-901-a2a "${ARGS[@]}"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  for f in fixture.yaml head.diff PR.md REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md head/scripts/a.sh head/scripts/b.sh base/scripts/a.sh; do
+    [ -f "$C/pr-90/$f" ]
+  done
+  grep -q '^sprint: 901$' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
+  grep -q "^head_commit: \"$HEAD_C\"$" "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
+  grep -q "^fix_commit: \"$FIX\"$" "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
+  grep -q '^record_ref: "record/cycle-901-a2a"$' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
+  grep -q 'grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-901/engineer-feedback-r1.md' "$C/pr-90/fixture.yaml"
+  # the labels never sit in the directory the sandbox copies
+  [ -z "$(find "$C/pr-90" -name 'labels*' -o -name '*.dropped.txt')" ]
+  L="$C/labels/pr-90.tsv"
+  [ "$(head -1 "$L")" = "# approved-by: pending" ]
+  grep -qx "$(printf 'defect_id\tseverity\tcategory\tfile\tmust_match\tlabel_source\tsource')" "$L"
+  # kept: the a.sh finding (its fix touches a.sh), anchored where the fix inserts
+  # the missing check (after `local v="$1"`) and on the short function's definition
+  [ "$(awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^L/ {print $4 "|" $6}' "$L" | sort -u)" = "scripts/a.sh|review" ]
+  awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^L01-/ {print $5}' "$L" | grep -qxF 'local v="$1"'
+  awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^L01-/ {print $5}' "$L" | grep -qxF 'check_input() {'
+  # dropped by the rule: b.sh (the fix never touches it); the prose finding; the previous-round section is never read
+  grep -q 'fix commit does not touch scripts/b.sh' "$C/labels/pr-90.dropped.txt"
+  grep -q 'no code locus' "$C/labels/pr-90.dropped.txt"
+  ! grep -q 'must never be read' "$L" "$C/labels/pr-90.dropped.txt"
+  # fix rows: one per fix hunk, on a.sh and c.sh, sourced fix/<sha>:<start>-<end>
+  [ "$(awk -F'\t' '$6 == "fix" {print $4}' "$L" | sort | tr '\n' ,)" = "scripts/a.sh,scripts/c.sh," ]
+  awk -F'\t' '$6 == "fix" {print $7}' "$L" | grep -qE "^fix/${FIX:0:12}:[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"
+  # the hidden manifest, the tasks, the corpus row and the freeze
+  M="$C/manifests/pr-90.json"
+  [ "$(jq -r '.approved' "$M")" = "false" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.defects | length' "$M")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.fix_regions | length' "$M")" = "2" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.defects[0].label_source' "$M")" = "review" ]
+  [ -f "$K/review-recall/review-pr-90.yaml" ] && [ -f "$K/audit-recall/audit-pr-90.yaml" ]
+  [ "$(yq -r '.graders[0].args[0]' "$K/review-recall/review-pr-90.yaml")" = "pr-90" ]
+  grep -q "^pr-90	record	${HEAD_C:0:8}	labels/pr-90.tsv" "$C/corpus.tsv"
+  run "$SEED" --check --corpus "$C"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SC-2 a finding carrying a secret is rejected without its text; nothing written carries the key and every file passes no-secrets.sh" {
+  run "$SEED" 901 record/cycle-901-a2a "${ARGS[@]}"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -q 'secret pattern in the finding text' "$C/labels/pr-90.dropped.txt"
+  ! grep -rqF "$FAKE_KEY" "$C"
+  ! awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^L/ {print $4}' "$C/labels/pr-90.tsv" | grep -q 'c.sh'
+  run bash "$REPO_ROOT/evals/graders/no-secrets.sh" "$C"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "SC-3 recall-vs-defects.sh grades the seeded label: the anchor detects it, a fix region is not refuted, an unrelated line is" {
+  run "$SEED" 901 record/cycle-901-a2a "${ARGS[@]}"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  local at; at="$(jq -r '.defects[0].anchor_line' "$C/manifests/pr-90.json")"
+  W="$T/ws"; mkdir -p "$W"
+  printf '%s\n' "- HIGH head/scripts/a.sh:$at accepts an empty value" "- LOW head/scripts/c.sh:3 prints the token" \
+    "- LOW head/scripts/b.sh:2 loops forever" > "$W/review.md"
+  EVAL_MANIFEST_DIR="$C/manifests" run "$GRADER" "$W" pr-90 review.md
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.details.recall == 1')" = "true" ]
+  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.details.findings_cited')" = "3" ]
+  [ "$(echo "$output" | jq -r '.details.findings_refuted')" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "SC-4 the approved-by header is required; --approve records the approver, marks the manifest approved and refreezes" {
+  run "$SEED" 901 record/cycle-901-a2a "${ARGS[@]}"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  L="$C/labels/pr-90.tsv"
+  cp "$L" "$T/keep.tsv"
+  tail -n +2 "$T/keep.tsv" > "$L"
+  run "$SEED" --build-manifest pr-90 --corpus "$C"
+  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
+  grep -q 'approved-by' <<<"$output"

7883	+#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /

7994	+      END { printf "%d\n", s }
7995	+    ')"
7996	+

7999	+TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
8000	+MODEL_CALLS=""

8004	+      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
8005	+      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
8006	+      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the kind-count and volume-ratio release-notes lines over a fixture
+# git repository and a fixture MODELINV log (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    SCRIPT="${PROJECT_ROOT}/tools/cycle-ratio.sh"
+    R="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/repo"
+    mkdir -p "$R"
+    cd "$R"
+    g() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null "$@"; }
+    g init -q .
+    printf 'echo 1\necho 2\n' > a.sh
+    printf 'hello\nworld\n' > doc.md
+    printf 'not counted\n' > notes.txt
+    g add -A
+    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-01T00:00:00Z' g commit -q -m base
+    FROM="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+    # a.sh: +3 -1; b.py: +2; c.ts: +1; doc.md: -"hello" +"hi there"; notes.txt and a binary not counted
+    printf 'echo 1\necho 3\necho 4\necho 5\n' > a.sh
+    printf 'x = 1\ny = 2\n' > b.py
+    printf 'export {}\n' > c.ts
+    printf 'hi there\nworld\n' > doc.md
+    printf 'more\nlines\n' >> notes.txt
+    printf '\000\001\002' > blob.sh
+    g add -A
+    GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-10-02T00:00:00Z' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-10-02T00:00:00Z' g commit -q -m change
+    TO="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
+    mkdir -p grimoires/loa .run
+    {
+        printf '# Sprint Plan: fixture\n\n**Date:** 2026-10-14\n\n## Sprint 1: One\n\n'
+        printf '### Acceptance Criteria\n- [ ] AC-1 not a task · kind: operator\n\n'
+        printf '### Technical Tasks\n'
+        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.1: a → **[G-1]** ⇐ none · kind: mechanical\n'
+        printf -- '- [x] Task 1.2: b → **[G-1]** · kind:mechanical\n'
+        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.3: c → **[G-1]** · kind: judgment\n'
+        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.4: d → **[G-1]** · kind: operator\n'
+        printf -- '- [ ] Task 1.5: untagged → **[G-1]**\n'
+        printf '```\n- [ ] Task 9.9: fenced · kind: mechanical\n```\n\n'
+        printf '## Sprint 2 (Final): Two\n\n### Task 2.E2E: End-to-End Goal Validation\n'
+        printf -- '- [ ] Task 2.E2E: validate → **[G-1]** · kind: judgment\n\n'
+        printf '**Acceptance Criteria:**\n- [ ] Each goal validated · kind: mechanical\n\n'
+        printf '## Appendix\n\n- [ ] Task 3.1: outside a sprint · kind: mechanical\n'
+    } > grimoires/loa/sprint.md
+    {
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-09-30T23:59:59.500000Z"}'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-01T12:00:00.123456Z"}'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-02T00:00:00Z"}'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"2026-10-02T00:00:01Z"}'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"OTHER","ts_utc":"2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"}'
+        printf '%s\n' 'not json at all'
+        printf '%s\n' '{"primitive_id":"MODELINV","ts_utc":"garbage"}'
+    } > .run/model-invoke.jsonl
+}
+
+@test "CR-1 prints both lines with the counts, the mapping and the provenance" {
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$output" == *"kinds: mechanical 2 · judgment 2 · operator 1"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"volume: script lines changed 7 (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed 15 (*.md) · model calls 2 (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: ${R}/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"* ]]
+    # the untagged task line is named on stderr (bats merges it into output)
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: 1 task line(s)"*"carry no kind: tag"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "CR-2 --json carries the same figures, the window and the untagged count" {
+    run bash -c '"$0" --from "$1" --to "$2" --json 2>/dev/null' "$SCRIPT" "$FROM" "$TO"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.mechanical' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.judgment' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.operator' <<< "$output")" = 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.kinds.untagged' <<< "$output")" = 1 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.script_lines_changed' <<< "$output")" = 7 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.prose_bytes_changed' <<< "$output")" = 15 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.model_calls' <<< "$output")" = 2 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.scope' <<< "$output")" = host ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.window.from' <<< "$output")" = "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.window.to' <<< "$output")" = "2026-10-02T00:00:00Z" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.from' <<< "$output")" = "$FROM" ]
+}
+
+@test "CR-3 a missing MODELINV log yields model calls n/a and a WARN, exit 0" {
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO" --modelinv "$R/.run/absent.jsonl"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$output" == *"model calls n/a (MODELINV rows"* ]]
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: MODELINV log not found at $R/.run/absent.jsonl"* ]]
+    run bash -c '"$0" --from "$1" --to "$2" --modelinv /nonexistent --json 2>/dev/null' "$SCRIPT" "$FROM" "$TO"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.volume.model_calls' <<< "$output")" = null ]
+}
+
+@test "CR-4 an unknown SHA exits 3; a SHA shaped like a flag exits 3" {
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 --to "$TO"
+    [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"unknown commit"* ]]
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to --output=/tmp/x
+    [ "$status" -eq 3 ]
+}
+
+@test "CR-5 usage errors exit 2: a missing --to, an unknown flag, an unreadable plan, outside a repo" {
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO" --bogus
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    run "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO" --sprint-plan "$R/nope.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+    mkdir -p "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/norepo"
+    cd "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}/norepo"
+    run env GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}" "$SCRIPT" --from "$FROM" --to "$TO"
+    [ "$status" -eq 2 ]
+}
+
+@test "CR-6 an explicit --sprint-plan is read; a plan with no task lines counts zero" {
+    printf '# Plan\n\n## Sprint 1: x\n\n### Technical Tasks\n- [ ] T · kind: operator\n' > "$R/other.md"
+    run bash -c '"$0" --from "$1" --to "$2" --sprint-plan "$3" 2>/dev/null' "$SCRIPT" "$FROM" "$TO" "$R/other.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [[ "$output" == *"kinds: mechanical 0 · judgment 0 · operator 1"* ]]
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD AC-1.5, SDD §1.6, D-9.2)
+# The floor does not move: every floor_files entry of .claude/data/floor.yaml
+# and the fence-corpus rows named under floor_corpus are byte-identical to
+# origin/main; the register disables nothing, so the .claude/settings.json hook
+# registrations and the fence's pattern-id call-site list are identical too.
+# Skipped, with a message, when origin/main is not reachable (a shallow CI
+# checkout); the floor.yaml sha256 pin in guard-origins.bats still runs there.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
+  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
+  FLOOR="$ROOT/.claude/data/floor.yaml"
+  if ! git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --verify -q 'origin/main^{commit}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    skip "origin/main is not reachable from this checkout (shallow clone?): the floor snapshot needs it — run 'git fetch origin main'"
+  fi
+  BASE="$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse 'origin/main^{commit}')"
+}
+
+base_show() { git -C "$ROOT" show "$BASE:$1"; }
+
+@test "FS-1 every floor_files entry is byte-identical to origin/main" {
+  n=0
+  while IFS= read -r f; do
+    [ -n "$f" ] || continue
+    n=$((n + 1))
+    git -C "$ROOT" cat-file -e "$BASE:$f" || { echo "$f is not on origin/main" >&2; false; }
+    base_show "$f" | cmp -s - "$ROOT/$f" || { echo "floor file $f differs from origin/main" >&2; false; }
+  done < <(yq -r '.floor_files[]' "$FLOOR")
+  [ "$n" -ge 4 ]
+}
+
+@test "FS-2 the fence-corpus rows named in floor_corpus (FR-1.2b, FR-SZ*) are identical to origin/main" {
+  corpus="$(yq -r '.floor_corpus.file' "$FLOOR")"
+  rules="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.floor_corpus.rules' "$FLOOR")"
+  sel='def m($r): $r | any(.[]; . as $p | if ($p | endswith("*")) then ($in.rule // "" | startswith($p | rtrimstr("*"))) else ($in.rule // "") == $p end);
+       . as $in | select(m($rules))'
+  diff <(base_show "$corpus" | jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel") <(jq -c --argjson rules "$rules" "$sel" "$ROOT/$corpus")
+}
+
+@test "FS-3 the register disables nothing: settings.json hook registrations are identical to origin/main" {
+  diff <(base_show .claude/settings.json | jq -c '.hooks') <(jq -c '.hooks' "$ROOT/.claude/settings.json")
+}
+
+@test "FS-4 the fence's pattern-id call-site list (in order) is identical to origin/main" {
+  ids() { grep -oE 'emit_block "[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"|pattern_id(: |=)"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"'; }
+  diff <(base_show .claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh | ids) <(ids < "$ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh")
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/guard-origins.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 AC-1.1, SDD D-1.6)
+# The origin map .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml covers every guard the
+# repository enumerates: every hook script registered in .claude/settings.json,
+# every fence pattern id in block-destructive-bash.sh, every validator rule
+# marker in validate-artifact.sh, the fixed gate list and the floor policies.
+# The enumeration here is independent of guard-yield.sh (its own jq/grep), so a
+# bug in the script cannot hide a gap. Fixture copies prove the failure modes.
+# =============================================================================
+
+# The sha256 of .claude/data/floor.yaml. An edit to the floor fails this suite
+# until the pin is updated deliberately, in the same change, with a reviewer:
+#   bash -c 'source .claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh; sha256_portable .claude/data/floor.yaml'
+FLOOR_SHA256="bd1f22dce9b6f18a0fda36d5a65dacd8103075c66c8c649b21de04fffcc92587"
+
+setup() {
+  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
+  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
+  GY="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh"
+  MAP="$ROOT/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml"
+  FLOOR="$ROOT/.claude/data/floor.yaml"
+  SETTINGS="$ROOT/.claude/settings.json"
+  FENCE="$ROOT/.claude/hooks/safety/block-destructive-bash.sh"
+  VALIDATOR="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gorig.XXXXXX")"
+  # Fixture outputs never touch the tracked register or the live .run.
+  OUTARGS=(--out "$T/guards.md" --yield-dir "$T/run" --audit-log "$T/no-audit.jsonl")
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+# ids of every registered hook script, derived independently of guard-yield.sh
+enumerated_hook_ids() {
+  jq -r '.hooks | to_entries[] | .value[] | .hooks[].command' "$SETTINGS" \
+    | grep -oE '\.claude/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+\.sh' | sed -e 's#^\.claude/##' \
+    | sed -e 's#^hooks/#hook:#' -e 's#^scripts/#hook:scripts/#' | sort -u
+}
+enumerated_fence_ids() {
+  grep -vE '^[[:space:]]*#' "$FENCE" | grep -oE 'emit_block "[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"|pattern_id(: |=)"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"' \
+    | sed -E 's/.*"([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)"$/fence:\1/' | sort -u
+}
+enumerated_validator_ids() {
+  grep -oE '^[[:space:]]*# @guard validator:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+' "$VALIDATOR" | sed -E 's/.*validator:/validator:/' | sort -u
+}
+map_ids() { yq -r ".guards[] | select(.kind == \"$1\") | .id" "$MAP" | sort -u; }
+
+@test "GO-1 the origin map and floor.yaml parse with yq v4 and carry schema_version 1" {
+  run yq --version
+  [[ "$output" == *mikefarah*"version v4."* ]]
+  [ "$(yq '.schema_version' "$MAP")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(yq '.schema_version' "$FLOOR")" = "1" ]
+  [ "$(yq '.guards | length' "$MAP")" -gt 0 ]
+}
+
+@test "GO-2 floor.yaml sha256 is pinned (update FLOOR_SHA256 deliberately when the floor changes)" {
+  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
+  actual="$(sha256_portable "$FLOOR" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
+  [ "$actual" = "$FLOOR_SHA256" ] || { echo "floor.yaml sha256 $actual != pinned $FLOOR_SHA256" >&2; false; }
+}
+
+@test "GO-3 every registered hook script has a row with a non-empty origin, and every hook row is registered" {
+  hooks="$(enumerated_hook_ids)"
+  [ "$(wc -l <<<"$hooks")" -ge 29 ]
+  while IFS= read -r id; do
+    ref="$(yq -r ".guards[] | select(.id == \"$id\") | .origin.ref // \"\"" "$MAP")"
+    [ -n "$ref" ] || { echo "hook $id has no row with an origin" >&2; false; }
+  done <<<"$hooks"
+  diff <(echo "$hooks") <(map_ids hook)
+}
+
+@test "GO-4 every fence pattern id (emit_block sites and pattern_id constants) has a row, and every fence row is a pattern id" {
+  fences="$(enumerated_fence_ids)"
+  [ "$(wc -l <<<"$fences")" -ge 32 ]
+  grep -qx 'fence:FR-1.2b' <<<"$fences"
+  diff <(echo "$fences") <(map_ids fence)
+  while IFS= read -r id; do
+    [ -n "$(yq -r ".guards[] | select(.id == \"$id\") | .origin.ref // \"\"" "$MAP")" ]
+  done <<<"$fences"
+}
+
+@test "GO-5 every validator rule marker has a row, and every validator row has a marker" {
+  v="$(enumerated_validator_ids)"
+  [ "$(wc -l <<<"$v")" -ge 13 ]
+  diff <(echo "$v") <(map_ids validator)
+}
+
+@test "GO-6 the fixed gate list and the floor policies are present and every gate or policy script exists" {
+  for g in verdict-derive adversarial-review-gate implement-gate success-criteria dissent-budget seams kinds prompt-budget guard-origins; do
+    [ "$(yq -r ".guards[] | select(.id == \"gate:$g\") | .id" "$MAP")" = "gate:$g" ]
+  done
+  for p in permission-deny-list verdict-one-way-rule operator-only-commands; do
+    [ "$(yq -r ".guards[] | select(.id == \"policy:$p\") | .id" "$MAP")" = "policy:$p" ]
+  done
+  while IFS= read -r s; do
+    [ -f "$ROOT/$s" ] || { echo "gate/policy script $s missing" >&2; false; }
+  done < <(yq -r '.guards[] | select(.kind == "gate" or .kind == "policy") | .script' "$MAP")
+}
+
+@test "GO-7 the floor: true rows are exactly floor.yaml floor_guards" {
+  diff <(yq -r '.floor_guards[]' "$FLOOR" | sort) <(yq -r '.guards[] | select(.floor == true) | .id' "$MAP" | sort)
+}
+
+@test "GO-8 enums hold, ids are unique and match the id pattern, origins are non-empty, dormant rows name an env var" {
+  [ -z "$(yq -r '.guards[].id' "$MAP" | sort | uniq -d)" ]
+  [ -z "$(yq -r '.guards[].id' "$MAP" | grep -vE '^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$' || true)" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select((.kind | test("^(hook|fence|validator|gate|policy)$")) | not)] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select((.class | test("^(harness|script|prose)$")) | not)] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select((.status | test("^(active|dormant|telemetry)$")) | not)] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select((.origin.kind | test("^(kf|issue|finding|cycle|design)$")) | not)] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select((.origin.ref // "") == "")] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  [ "$(yq '[.guards[] | select(.status == "dormant" and ((.knob | test("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$")) | not))] | length' "$MAP")" = "0" ]
+  for g in team-role-guard team-role-guard-write team-skill-guard; do
+    [ "$(yq -r ".guards[] | select(.id == \"hook:safety/$g.sh\") | .status + \" \" + .knob" "$MAP")" = "dormant LOA_TEAM_MEMBER" ]
+  done
+  [ "$(yq -r '.guards[] | select(.id == "hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh") | .status + " " + .knob' "$MAP")" = "active implement_gate.mode" ]
+}
+

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/guard-yield.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 AC-1.2 … AC-1.4,
+# SDD D-1.3, D-1.4)
+# guard-yield.sh over a fixture audit log and a rotated segment, at a fixed
+# --now: replay exclusion (flag, cwd, burst) counted in the header, the
+# likely-false-positive heuristic (heredoc, outside-repo cwd, prose class without
+# a destructive verb at statement start), day-granular last_real_catch, the
+# --check drift gate (0 after generation, 1 after an origin edit, 0 after a
+# yield-only change), the --json shape, and no command text or cwd in any output.
+# =============================================================================
+
+NOW="2026-10-14T12:00:00Z"
+
+setup() {
+  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
+  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
+  GY="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gyield.XXXXXX")"
+  T="$(cd "$T" && pwd -P)"
+  mkdir -p "$T/run" "$T/scratch"
+  # A temp prefix the fixture controls (the script's own mktemp also uses it).
+  export TMPDIR="$T"
+  cp "$ROOT/.claude/data/guard-origins.yaml" "$T/origins.yaml"
+  cp "$ROOT/.claude/loa/reference/hooks-reference.md" "$T/hooks-reference.md"
+  A="$T/audit.jsonl"
+  row() {  # ts pattern cwd command [extra-json]
+    jq -cn --arg ts "$1" --arg p "$2" --arg cwd "$3" --arg c "$4" --argjson x "${5:-{\}}" \
+      '{ts: $ts, tool: "Bash", command: $c, exit_code: 2, cwd: $cwd, model: "claude-test-model", hook: "block-destructive-bash", action: "block", pattern_id: $p, matched: "m"} + $x'
+  }
+  {
+    # live, inside the repo
+    row "2026-10-12T08:00:00Z" "FR-SZ2-REDIR" "$ROOT" "cat > .claude/x.md <<'EOF'"            # heredoc → likely FP
+    row "2026-10-12T09:00:00Z" "P2" "/srv/elsewhere/scratch" "git push --force origin topic"    # outside repo → likely FP
+    row "2026-10-12T10:00:00Z" "SP-1" "$ROOT" "br comments add bd-1 'note about spike/x merge'" # prose class, no verb → likely FP
+    row "2026-10-13T23:59:00Z" "FR-2-AMBIGUOUS" "$ROOT" "cd sub && rm -rf ./.cache"             # prose class WITH verb → real
+    # replays
+    row "2026-10-11T08:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~1" '{"replay": true}'        # flag
+    row "2026-10-11T09:00:00Z" "P3" "$T/scratch" "git reset --hard HEAD~2"                       # cwd under TMPDIR
+    row "2026-10-11T10:00:00Z" "P3" "/home/u/bats-run-42/repo" "git reset --hard HEAD~3"        # cwd /bats-run-
+    for s in 00 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09; do                                                  # burst: 10 in one minute
+      row "2026-10-09T10:00:${s}Z" "P2" "$ROOT" "git push --force origin main"
+    done
+    # outside the window
+    row "2026-08-01T08:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~9"
+    # implement-gate telemetry and ask
+    jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-12T11:00:00Z", hook: "implement-gate", action: "telemetry", cwd: "x"}'
+    jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-12T11:05:00Z", hook: "implement-gate", action: "ask", cwd: "x"}'
+    # a non-block row and an unparseable line
+    jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-12T11:10:00Z", tool: "Bash", command: "ls", cwd: "x"}'
+    printf 'this is not json\n'
+  } > "$A"
+  # the rotated segment holds the one real P3 catch
+  row "2026-10-10T09:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~3" > "$A.1"
+  ARGS=(--now "$NOW" --audit-log "$A" --origins "$T/origins.yaml" --out "$T/guards.md" --yield-dir "$T/run" --hooks-ref "$T/hooks-reference.md")
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+g() { jq -c --arg id "$1" '.guards[] | select(.id == $id) | [.blocks_30d, .likely_fp_30d, .telemetry_30d, .last_real_catch]' "$T/run/guard-yield.json"; }

+  [ "$(jq -r '.scope' "$J")" = "host" ]

+  [ "$(g gate:implement-gate)" = '[0,0,2,"none in window"]' ]

+@test "GY-5 no command text, cwd, hostname or model name reaches guards.md, the yield files or the hooks table" {

+  [ "$(grep -cE '^\| (hook|fence|validator|gate|policy):' "$T/guards.md")" -eq "$n" ]

+  jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-14T08:00:00Z", hook: "block-destructive-bash", action: "block", pattern_id: "P4", cwd: "/x", command: "git clean -fd"}' >> "$A"

+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}" --check

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/loa-status-guards.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 (PRD AC-1.5, SDD D-1.5)
+# `/loa` prints one Guards line: register counts from grimoires/loa/guards.md and
+# the 30-day host yield from .run/guard-yield.json (never recomputed at status
+# time), or the regenerate hint when the yield file is missing. Fixture files via
+# the bats-gated LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE / LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE seams.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  umask 022
+  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
+  PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+  STATUS="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/loa-status.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/lsg.XXXXXX")"
+  mkdir -p "$T/run" "$T/env"
+  export LOA_STATUS_RUN_DIR="$T/run" LOA_STATUS_ENV_DIR="$T/env" LOA_STATUS_CONFIG_FILE="$T/no-loa-config.yaml"
+  printf '# Guard register\n\n- guards: 94\n- guards_without_origin: 0\n- dormant: 3\n- floor: 21\n' > "$T/guards.md"
+  jq -n '{schema_version: 1, generated_at: "2026-10-14", window_days: 30, scope: "host",
+          totals: {guards: 94, real_blocks_30d: 87, likely_fp_30d: 72}}' > "$T/guard-yield.json"
+  export LOA_STATUS_GUARDS_FILE="$T/guards.md" LOA_STATUS_GUARD_YIELD_FILE="$T/guard-yield.json"
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+@test "LSG-1 the Guards line carries the register counts and the host yield from the yield file" {
+  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  line="$(grep -E '^Guards: ' <<<"$output" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')"
+  [ "$line" = "Guards: 94 (0 without origin, 3 dormant) · 30 d: 87 real blocks, 72 likely FP · scope host · regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh" ]
+}
+
+@test "LSG-2 with no yield file the line keeps the structural counts and prints the regenerate hint" {
+  rm -f "$T/guard-yield.json"
+  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  line="$(grep -E '^Guards: ' <<<"$output" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g')"
+  [ "$line" = "Guards: 94 (0 without origin, 3 dormant) · 30 d: no yield file (.run/guard-yield.json) · regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh" ]
+}
+
+@test "LSG-3 a malformed yield file is treated as missing; a missing register says so" {
+  printf '{"totals": {"real_blocks_30d": "x; rm -rf /"}}\n' > "$T/guard-yield.json"
+  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -qE '^.*Guards: .*94 \(0 without origin, 3 dormant\) · 30 d: no yield file' <<<"$output"
+  [[ "$output" != *"rm -rf"* ]]
+  rm -f "$T/guards.md"
+  run timeout 120 bash "$STATUS" --no-stale-check
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  grep -qE 'Guards: .*no register \(grimoires/loa/guards.md\) · regenerate: .claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh' <<<"$output"
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# Path-scoped rule files (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-3.1, DEC-0129): stash-safety.md and
+# skill-invariants.md carry `paths:` frontmatter, the frontmatter parses, and every glob
+# matches at least one tracked file of the kind the rule is about (git pathspec glob
+# semantics: `**` spans directories, `*` stays inside one).
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    RULES="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/rules"
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not installed"
+}
+
+# The YAML between the first two '---' lines (empty when the file has none).
+frontmatter() { awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" { exit } /^---$/ { if (n++) exit; next } n' "$1"; }
+globs() { frontmatter "$1" | yq eval '.paths[]' -; }
+tracked() { git -C "$PROJECT_ROOT" ls-files -- ":(glob)$1"; }
+
+@test "RP-1 both rule files open with frontmatter that parses and lists string globs under paths:" {
+    local f n
+    for f in stash-safety.md skill-invariants.md; do
+        [ "$(head -1 "$RULES/$f")" = "---" ] || { echo "$f has no frontmatter"; return 1; }
+        frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.' - >/dev/null || { echo "$f frontmatter does not parse"; return 1; }
+        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | type' -)" = "!!seq" ]
+        n="$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '.paths | length' -)"
+        [ "$n" -ge 1 ]
+        [ "$(frontmatter "$RULES/$f" | yq eval '[.paths[] | select(type != "!!str")] | length' -)" -eq 0 ]
+    done
+}
+
+@test "RP-2 the globs are the ones the SDD names" {
+    [ "$(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '**/*.sh **/*.bats .claude/scripts/** .claude/hooks/** ' ]
+    [ "$(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md" | tr '\n' ' ')" = '.claude/skills/**/SKILL.md .claude/agents/** .claude/data/agent-types.yaml .claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities.sh ' ]
+}
+
+@test "RP-3 every stash-safety glob matches a tracked shell source" {
+    local g hits
+    while IFS= read -r g; do
+        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '\.(sh|bats)$' | head -1)"
+        [ -n "$hits" ] || { echo "glob '$g' matches no tracked .sh/.bats file"; return 1; }
+    done < <(globs "$RULES/stash-safety.md")
+}
+
+@test "RP-4 every skill-invariants glob matches a tracked skill, agent definition or capability file" {
+    local g hits
+    while IFS= read -r g; do
+        hits="$(tracked "$g" | grep -E '(^\.claude/skills/[^/]+/SKILL\.md$|^\.claude/agents/[^/]+\.md$|^\.claude/data/agent-types\.yaml$|^\.claude/scripts/validate-skill-capabilities\.sh$)' | head -1)"
+        [ -n "$hits" ] || { echo "glob '$g' matches no tracked file of the intended kind"; return 1; }
+    done < <(globs "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")
+}
+
+@test "RP-5 path-scoping removed no rule text: the body after the frontmatter keeps its heading and sections" {
+    local body
+    body="$(awk '/^---$/ && c < 2 { c++; next } c >= 2' "$RULES/stash-safety.md")"
+    [[ "$body" == *"# Git Stash Safety"* && "$body" == *"## Judgment rules the fence cannot express"* ]]
+    body="$(awk '/^---$/ && c < 2 { c++; next } c >= 2' "$RULES/skill-invariants.md")"
+    [[ "$body" == *"# Skill Frontmatter Invariants"* && "$body" == *"## The invariant"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "RP-6 the rule-lifecycle validator accepts both files (origin, version, enacted_by)" {
+    run "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/validate-rule-lifecycle.sh" --json
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# validate-artifact.sh --type sprint: every task line ends with exactly one
+# 'kind: mechanical|judgment|operator' token, gated on the plan's header **Date:**
+# (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.1; KINDS_REQUIRED_FROM=2026-10-14; DEC-0144, DEC-0154).
+
+setup() {
+    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "${BATS_TEST_DIRNAME}/../.." && pwd)"
+    SCRIPT="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/scripts/validate-artifact.sh"
+    T="${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR}"
+}
+
+# One sprint block; $1 = the Technical Tasks lines (printf-ready, one per line).
+sprint_body() {
+    printf '### Sprint Goal\ng\n\n### Deliverables\n- [ ] d\n\n### Acceptance Criteria\n- [ ] c\n\n'
+    printf '### Technical Tasks\n%s\n\n' "$1"
+    printf '### Seams Under Test\n| Seam | Catches | Misses | Prior art |\n|------|---------|--------|-----------|\n| `tool.sh` exit code | a wrong exit | prose | new |\n\n'
+    printf '### Dependencies\n- none\n\n### Security Considerations\n- none\n\n'
+    printf '### Risks & Mitigation\n| Risk | Probability | Impact | Mitigation |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| r | Low | Low | m |\n\n'
+    printf '### Success Metrics\n- m\n\n'
+}
+# $1 = header date (may be empty); $2 = sprint 1 task lines; $3 = the E2E task line.
+plan() {
+    printf '# Sprint Plan: x\n\n**Version:** 1.0\n'
+    [[ -n "$1" ]] && printf '**Date:** %s\n' "$1"
+    printf '**Author:** test\n\n---\n\n'
+    printf '## Sprint 1: Foundation\n\n'; sprint_body "$2"
+    printf '## Sprint 2 (Final): Wrap-up\n\n'
+    sprint_body '- [ ] Task 2.1: wire the thing → **[G-1]** ⇐ Task 1.1 · kind: mechanical'
+    printf '### Task 2.E2E: End-to-End Goal Validation\n%s\n\n' "$3"
+    printf '**Acceptance Criteria:**\n- [ ] Each goal validated with documented evidence\n\n'
+    printf '## Appendix\n\n| Goal ID | Goal |\n|---|---|\n| G-1 | thing |\n'
+}
+TAGGED='- [ ] Task 1.1: add the tool → **[G-1]** ⇐ none · kind: mechanical'
+E2E='- [ ] Task 2.E2E: validate every goal → **[G-1]** ⇐ Task 2.1 · kind: judgment'

+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$output" == *"sprint.md:"*": a task line has no kind: token"*"on or after 2026-10-14"* ]]
+    [ "$(grep -c 'kind: token' <<< "$output")" -eq 1 ]
+}
+
+@test "KINDS-2 the same plan with every task tagged passes without a kind message" {
+    plan 2026-10-14 "$TAGGED" "$E2E" > "$T/sprint.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$output" != *"kind:"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "KINDS-3 a plan dated before 2026-10-14 with untagged tasks passes with one WARN" {
+    plan 2026-10-13 '- [ ] Task 1.1: add the tool → **[G-1]** ⇐ none' \
+        '- [ ] Task 2.E2E: validate every goal → **[G-1]**' > "$T/sprint.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"

+    [[ "$output" == *"carries 2 kind: tokens; keep exactly one"* ]]
+}
+
+@test "KINDS-5 trailing prose after the value fails; an unknown value fails" {
+    plan 2026-10-14 '- [ ] Task 1.1: add the tool → **[G-1]** · kind: mechanical (see notes)' "$E2E" > "$T/sprint.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"

+    [[ "$output" == *"has text after its kind: value"* ]]

+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"

+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    [[ "$output" == *"WARN: undated plan: 1 task line(s) without a valid kind: tag"* ]]

+@test "KINDS-7 a judgment task naming only script files or a script verb WARNs and still passes" {

+    # the E2E task line untagged on a dated plan fails
+    plan 2026-10-14 "$TAGGED" '- [ ] Task 2.E2E: validate every goal → **[G-1]**' > "$T/sprint.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"
+    [ "$status" -eq 1 ] || { echo "$output"; return 1; }
+    local le; le="$(grep -n 'Task 2.E2E: validate' "$T/sprint.md" | cut -d: -f1)"
+    [[ "$output" == *"sprint.md:${le}: a task line has no kind: token"* ]]
+    # a backticked `kind:` in the prose is not a second token; spacing around the colon
+    # is tolerated; the dependency marker may be absent; a fenced checkbox is not a task
+    plan 2026-10-14 '- [ ] Task 1.1: add the `kind:` rule → **[G-1]** ·   kind :  operator
+- [x] Task 1.2: done already · kind:mechanical
+```
+- [ ] not a task
+```' "$E2E" > "$T/sprint.md"
+    run "$SCRIPT" --type sprint --file "$T/sprint.md"
